name: Asher
overview: Asher, whose name means 'happy' or 'blessed,' is introduced in Scripture as one of Jacob's sons through Zilpah, Leah's handmaid, highlighting his place within the patriarchal family (Genesis 30:13; 35:26). His descendants formed one of the twelve tribes of Israel, counted in the census and organized by families, demonstrating God's orderly provision for His people (Numbers 1:40). The tribe of Asher was known for its abundant provision, as symbolized by the blessing of yielding rich produce and royal delicacies (Genesis 49:20). These details emphasize God's faithfulness in establishing Asher both as a person and as a tribe within His covenant community.
